title: HtmlRp
responsibility: Renders the native rp element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlRp.attributes
inputs.description: Native rp attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlRp.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native rp element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlRp
outputs.description: The actual native rp element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
